title: MiniSigillinValidatorResult
description: Result payload emitted by scripts/sigils/mini-sigillin-validator.ts when evaluating a Mandala explanation.

hasCrepReference.description: True when at least one CREP metric (Coherence, Resonance, Emergence, Poetics) is referenced.

hasTrikayaMapping.description: True when the response references at least one Trikāya layer (Dharmakāya, Sambhogakāya, Nirmāṇakāya).

hasNextAction.description: True when the response contains an actionable follow-up (e.g., Mini-Sigillin, Hypothese, Messpunkt).

isSafe.description: False when disallowed phrases such as 'falsche Daten' or 'unklare Fakten' are detected.

passes.description: True only when all checks are satisfied.

matches.description: Matched fragments for each rule to aid debugging.

nextAction.description: Distinct fragments referencing next steps or rituals.

unsafe.description: Detected unsafe phrases triggering safety warnings.
